app.title: dcdash
app.tagline: Dashboard for central data center services

home.failing: One component has a problem. | {n} components have a problem.

login.title: Log in
login.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryHint: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.

enroll.title: Set up an authenticator app
enroll.introRequired: Your account requires a second login step. Set up an authenticator app now.
enroll.introVoluntary: Protect your account with a second login step.
enroll.step1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example on your phone).
enroll.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm.
enroll.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
enroll.manual: Can't scan? Show the key for manual entry
enroll.done: The authenticator app is set up.

recovery.intro: Store these recovery codes in a safe place. If you lose your device, each code lets you log in once. They are shown only now.

account.title: My account
account.totpOptional: Your roles don't require it, but you can set it up to protect your account. Once set up, it is required at every login.
account.regenerateHint: Enter a current code from your authenticator app. Your old recovery codes stop working.

audit.actionHint: Exact, or a prefix ending with * (for example auth.*)

sessions.terminateText: Terminate this session of {user}? The user has to log in again.
sessions.terminateOwn: This is your own session. You will be logged out.
sessions.terminateAll: Terminate all sessions of this user
sessions.terminatedCount: No sessions were active. | One session was terminated. | {n} sessions were terminated.
sessions.resetTotpHint: For users who lost their device and their recovery codes. Directory users set up a new app at their next login; the break-glass account must be set up on the server.
sessions.resetTotpText: Reset the authenticator app of {user}? The user's recovery codes stop working as well.
sessions.resetDone: The authenticator app of {user} was reset.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.text: You don't have permission to open this page.

proxmox.noClusters: No Proxmox cluster is available to you.
proxmox.noGuests: No virtual machines or containers match the filter.

confirm.stop: Stop {name} immediately? This is like pulling the power plug: unsaved data is lost.
confirm.suspend: Suspend {name}? The guest is paused until it is resumed.

proxmox.taskUnknown: The result of {task} is unknown. Check the task in Proxmox.

errors.network_error: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.internal_error: An internal error occurred. Please try again later.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.csrf_failed: The request was rejected for security reasons. Please reload the page.
errors.invalid_credentials: The user name or password is wrong.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.directory_unavailable: The user directory is not available. Please try again later.
errors.totp_not_enrolled: No authenticator app is set up for this account. An administrator must set it up on the server.
errors.invalid_code: The code is wrong, expired or was already used.
errors.wrong_stage: This step is not possible right now. Please log in again.
errors.already_enrolled: An authenticator app is already set up.
errors.no_enrollment: The setup was not started or has expired. Please start again.
errors.upstream_unavailable: The backend cannot be reached. Please try again later.
errors.upstream_forbidden: The backend refused the request. The access rights of dcdash on the backend may be missing.
errors.terminal_unavailable: Terminals are not available for this cluster, because no console user is configured in dcdash.
